name: volna-music
description: Volna music player with personal discovery and library import
author: Volna

scripts.desktop:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win portable --x64
scripts.release:windows: npm run export:html && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win portable --x64 && python3 scripts/package_release.py --windows
scripts.format: prettier --write src server e2e scripts/*.mjs *.ts *.json index.html public/manifest.webmanifest README.md
